slice: channel domain to runtime bridge: persistent bindings, invalidation bridge and read-only projection
purpose: Bridge the H6a channel domain into the conversation/runtime path: persistent channelRef->conversationId bindings with CAS, same-transaction invalidation into ConversationDomain (audience version/session epoch), pull-based pending bridge, identity mapping into ConversationStore/RelationshipDomain, and a body-free read-only projection for the runtime snapshot.

baseline.head: 11d0c73
baseline.note: H0..H6a/H4d including H4d follow-up committed; 1345 baseline tests

implementation.bridge: new ChannelRuntimeBridge (host side): bindChannel via conversation.channelBind (idempotent, concurrent single row, CAS on expectedBindingVersion, cross-scope/unauthorized/forged/archived/invalid conversation rejected), bindings read, bridgePending over channel.invalidationsAfter with applied watermark idempotency, and a read-only ChannelRuntimeProjection (status/watermark/bindings/connections/conversations/pending/degraded; no bodies/summary/bodyRef/participant text; lossless JSON; 100 refreshes leave commitSeq unchanged; missing conversation domain is explicit degraded).
implementation.invalidation: IngressDomain.setInvalidationSink called inside the same transaction as audience/deletion changes; ConversationDomain.bridgeChannelInvalidation -> ConversationStore.invalidateAudience (audienceVersion++, reply sessionEpoch++), so an old draft becomes STALE_CONTEXT; a throwing sink rolls back channel change + ledger + conversation store together; unbound channels are a no-op.
implementation.identity: channelConversationKey/toConversationKey produces the exact existing ConversationKey shape and ensureConversation runs in the same transaction as the binding; channelParticipantAccount/InnerAccount is validated and fed to relationship.registerSubject: same short id/display name in two accounts yields two entity ids and the same tuple is idempotent.
implementation.workerIncrements: conversation-domain.ts adds the shiyu_channel_conversation_bindings table, three channel IPC commands and the same-Worker bridge method; ingress-domain.ts only adds the sink hook; protocol/worker/contracts untouched.
implementation.leadIntegrationPoint: Lead wires worker.ts (conversations domain creation -> ingress.setInvalidationSink(conversation bridge call)) and runtime.ts (channels field/constructor/snapshot projection; optional startup bridgePending reconciliation). Exact lines and code are in the teammate evidence.
